[Player Name: Ella Havier] 
[Title: Witch of the End]  
???
System, are you messing with me!!?

He traveled thousands of miles back home to attend his brother’s wedding.
Mu Yu was the child born from his father’s affair. The Mu family never liked him.
Neither did Mu Hanxiao.

119050.synopsis:
Being a mountain goddess is a skilled job.
Every day, you must answer the prayers of devotees, inspect the growth of crops in the fields, drive away bandits and wild beasts from outside, ensure fair trade for merchant caravans, and find time to sneak into the city for some roast chicken.
And at night, you must strive for self-improvement….
“I surrender, I surrender! Please don’t tell anyone…!”

119306.synopsis:
That year, Bai Chen, the nine-tailed fox yao [supernatural creature] of the Great Snow Mountain, lost his magical inner core. A once-in-a-generation prodigy, he faded from the stage before ever stepping into the world. Knowing his days were numbered, Bai Chen asked for only one thing before death: a Dao companion he truly liked, someone who would light incense for him during festivals once he was gone.
Later, he drew his last breath — without ever marrying the one he had set his heart on. Perhaps the regret was too deep, for that final breath never fully left his chest.
It all felt like a long dream. When Bai Chen awoke, five hundred years had passed. The former young master of the Great Snow Mountain had become an ancestor of the yao race. And the man who once ignored him — Li Wuming — had, without permission, gone and married him!

121354.synopsis:
As a necromancer, Chen Mo’s style took a sharp turn into the absurd from the moment a bloodline sacrifice ritual accidentally connected him to his own motherland.
While others summon zombies, my skeletons wield automatic rifles for physical exorcism.
While others summon dark knights, my skeletons snipe with heavy rifles, one shot, one soul.
While others summon flesh giants, my skeletons drive Type 59 tanks, embodying the art of explosion.
When sky-obscuring bone dragon legions roar toward him, Chen Mo calmly turns around and meticulously inputs an absurdly long set of coordinates.
[Hercules–Corona Borealis Great Wall—KBC Void—Sloan Great Wall—Pisces–Cetus Supercluster Complex… (omitting countless astronomical units)… Inner Solar System—Luna System—Blue Star—Eastern Xia Republic] 
A colossal entity tears through the dimensional barrier and emerges in all its glory.
“Allow me to introduce to you all! The ultimate avatar of violence, the divine oracle of truth, the unrivaled dominator of the seven seas, hailing from the great industrial Cthulhu deity of the East: the Type 055 Guided-Missile Destroyer, equipped with 112 vertical launch systems, a 130mm naval gun, an 1130 close-in weapon system, and HQ-10 short-range air defense missiles.”
“Oh, and thanks to the floating runes provided by my magic mentor, this bad boy is now officially the Type 055 Spaceborne Guided-Missile Destroyer.”
“Now, with Big Brother here, no offense, but every single one of you is tr*sh!”

123402.synopsis:
Erald, a young man leading a harsh and neglected life under his stepmother’s family, one day encounters the beautiful second prince, Chalon, who is secretly wandering through the forest.
Captivated by his angelic charm, Erald falls in love at first sight. Chalon, meanwhile, is bound by the possessive affection of his elder brother, the crown prince, and longs for a true friend.
Drawn together by fate, the two begin to meet in a secluded forest villa, and before long, they become hopelessly entangled in a secret romance.
Then, a grand ball is held at the castle. Driven by a desperate desire to see Chalon again, Erald makes his way there—only to incur the wrath of the crown prince, who has discovered their forbidden bond…!?
A wildly popular, intensely passionate and sensual fairy tale!!
associated_names: シンデレラ王 ～罪を抱く二人～

141834.synopsis:
This is the story of a radiant girl of light and a brooding boy of darkness—falling in love in dazzling, rainbow-colored hues.
They sit in the same room, doing nothing but playing games.
And yet, as they spend those quiet moments together, the distance between their hearts begins to shrink.
The beloved web hit finally comes to print!
Asahi Hikari—school idol, tennis prodigy, and part-time model—is a sunshine-tier extrovert blessed with talent, looks, and popularity.
In stark contrast, her classmate Kageyama Reiya is a hardcore gamer and a gloom-and-doom introvert with serious otaku energy.
Two people from opposite worlds who were never meant to cross paths.
But everything changes when a chance encounter on a bus reveals their shared love for games.
From that day on, Hikari starts dropping by Reiya’s room every weekend.
Same room. Same games. Just the two of them.
As the weekends pile up, so does the warmth between them.
“Alright then, I’ll be over tomorrow at the usual time, so get ready, okay?”
This is the story of a girl of light and a boy of darkness—falling in love in a shimmer of rainbow colors.
associated_names: 光属性美少女の朝日さんがなぜか毎週末俺の部屋に入り浸るようになった件

153866.synopsis:
Ye Feng transmigrated and became the protagonist of a xianxia novel he had read.
But tragically, the novel turned out to be a villain-centric story.
He would be relentlessly suppressed by all kinds of villains carrying cheat systems, until eventually meeting his end.
Ye Feng racked his brains so hard it felt like his CPU was going to burn out, but still couldn’t think of any way to change his fate.
Helpless, he decided to slack off.
Unexpectedly, that activated the Slack-Off System.
Call off an engagement? Sure, let’s return the betrothal gifts too!
Labeled a good-for-nothing? Fine by me. At least I won’t waste thousands of years on detours!
Old man in the ring? If you’re so capable, do it yourself—stop feeding me empty promises!
Watching the Child of Destiny Ye Feng completely slack off, the villains started to panic.
“If you’re like this, how are we supposed to exploit you?!”

202762.synopsis:
Standing before Richard, the transmigrator, were both good news and bad news.
Good news: He had transmigrated into the body of a wealthy young noble.
Bad news: He found himself in the unfamiliar land of Europa.
Good news: The Pohlania Republic was a prosperous nation blessed with abundant deposits of Star Steel.
Bad news: The date was September 1st, 939 of the Covenant Calendar, and Pohlania was about to be crushed by the Talmenreich Empire’s devastating Blitzkrieg.
As Richard watched the Stuka dive-bombers screaming down from the skies above, he felt like crying.
“This place is terrifying! Send me home already!”
Six years passed in the blink of an eye.
By then, Richard had earned many titles.
He was recognized by all Pohlanians as the greatest national hero of the twentieth century.
He was the nemesis of the Desert Fox.
He was the legendary White Death, credited with the highest number of enemy officer kills in history.
And he was the battlefield commander who led his nation from the brink of destruction to ultimate victory…

1004042.synopsis:
Edward, an 18-year-old college student, found himself stuck inside of a dark abyss.

[Spawning Dungeon Champion]

Without a word of warning, He found himself in an unfamiliar body being forced to attack trespassers. Will he ever find a way out? Or will he be a tool for endless slaughter?

1005322.synopsis:
This is a world with incredible, extraordinary powers.
Sprites born from dishes, the competition between deliciousness and power, a journey under a starlit sky, challenges tied together by bonds.

1007114.synopsis:
Chained by slavery and yet craving freedom, such is the fate of Alpheo , a modern historian forced to live under the grip of slavery in a land where chaos would soon erupt.
As the empire of Rolmia plunges into civil war following the death of the emperor , his three ambitious sons vie for the throne. In the midst of this turmoil, Alpheo finds the chance to break his chain and escape, leading his companions into the ashes of war, trying to thrive in it, selling their swords to the highest bidder .
But beyond the borders of Rolmia, hungry eyes watch as the empire's grip loosens. The Sultanate of Azania, ever the opportunist, sees a chance to expand its domain and influence , while to the south, neighboring principalities breathe a sigh of relief as the once-dominant giant stumbles and falters.
In the north, the confederation of the Free Isle finds their chance to restore their old tradition of pillaging and piratery, denied to them by an empire that is now crumbling beneath itself.
In this crucible of conflict, where dynasties crumble and empires fall, Alpheo find his call and the chance to forge his own destiny amidst the ashes of empires.

1007370.synopsis:
As he transmigrates across the continent of Douqi, Gu He takes on the mantle of Alchemy King Gu He and gains an incredible power - the Ten Thousandfold disciple cashback system. This allows him to grant gifts to his disciples, which are then returned ten thousandfold.
"You have gifted Liu Ling the Green Lotus Core Flame, triggering a tenfold return and granting you the mighty Green Lotus Holy Fire!" the system announces as each gift brings Gu He greater power.
After three years of intense training, Xiao Yan returns proudly to the Yunlan Sect, eager to display his newfound strength.
"Don't underestimate this once poor youth!" he warns his former lover Nalan Yanran. "Today I'll show you what a true genius can do!"
But Nalan Yanran just smiles faintly. "Is that so?" she asks, as a terrifying Dou Emperor aura suddenly surges from her.
Shocked, Xiao Yan stammers in disbelief, "How did you become a Dou Emperor powerhouse?"
With an arrogant smile, Nalan Yanran replies, "With my master, anything is possible."

1009418.synopsis:
The last thing Kira Samia expects at work is to fall into bed with her arrogant, irresistibly hot boss, Tesah Clover. It’s a mistake—a steamy, mind-blowingly satisfying mistake. But a night of burning skin to skin with the super wealthy boss proves to have turned her world inside out when Kira finds out what kind of dirty mud she had fallen into.
Tesah has cultivated an enviable, manipulative lifestyle: dating his work, exotic destinations, and luxury without limits. He’s not looking to be domesticated, and certainly not by his second hand waitress—even though he can’t get her out of his mind. Still, he knows he has both the responsibility and say towards her and the pregnancy she claimed to be his.
Though Kira has no interest in Tesah's money, her lack of prospects gives her little choice but to get loan from the bank to repair the only inheritance she got from her mum. But her actions of avoiding him, makes him want her even more, and if Kira lets down her guard, she just might break the wall her heart had built so strong in a long time.

1010186.synopsis: Lin Dong, who has mastered both the divine medical arts and martial arts, has traveled from the mountains to the city. With divine medical arts in his left hand and unbeatable martial arts in his right, he roams freely in the city.

1011466.synopsis:
Alex was just another ordinary gamer—until the day he died. Struck down by a terminal illness, he found solace in his favorite game, a vast fantasy RPG filled with powerful warriors, intricate politics, and world-shaking events. But before he could see the game's ending, fate had other plans.
When he opens his eyes again, he’s no longer Alex from Earth. Instead, he’s Alex Dragonheart, a nameless extra in the very game he once played. Not a protagonist. Not even a villain. Just an unknown side character who was fated to die early, forgotten by history.
Armed with only half of the game’s knowledge, an unawakened bloodline, and a mysterious sealed skill, Alex is thrown into a brutal world where strength is everything. His beloved younger sister is sick and needs treatment, but his past self had been powerless to save her. Not anymore.
Determined to rewrite his fate, Alex will rise through the ranks, manipulate events from the shadows, and seize power that was never meant for him. If fate refuses to acknowledge him, then he’ll carve his own legend—one that even the gods will fear.
After all, in a world where only the strong survive, even an extra can become a nightmare.
( Okay guys just because there is a system tag does not mean he will get everything handed to him he will have to work hard to attain power because I will make it so )

1012234.synopsis: 【 Top Divine Doctor Novel, Absolutely Electrifying】Famed throughout Dragon Empire as the Sect Leader of the Holy Medicine Sect – Qin Han, unexpectedly reincarnated into another body, looked at his delicate wife and swore to redo everything, to slay the enemies behind it all. Simplicity and rudeness are my art of conduct, and ‘if you don’t agree, we fight’ is my attitude toward life! Think you can do whatever you want with money? Sorry, my bank account balance has more digits than your social security number! Think you can do whatever you want with power? Sorry, with a wave of my sleeve, leaders of various nations queue up waiting for my medical attention! Think you can do whatever you want with people? Sorry, at my command, the entire Holy Medicine Sect springs into action! Watch how the Sect Leader of the Holy Medicine Sect dominates the Flower Capital, punches bullies, steps on arrogant youths, and unifies the forceful world!

1013514.synopsis:
The soul Awakening is the only way out from living an ordinary and pitiful life of being at the mercy of others.
When sixteen-year-old Jonah’s turn comes, the “God serum” doesn’t grant him a normal talent — it nearly kills him, leaving behind a nine-headed golden Beast mark and a power the elites in the city can’t even fathom.
Thrown into the prestigious Mystic Phoenix Academy, Jonah discovers he’s not just a mage or warrior, he’s something even crazier: The strongest Beast master!
How is that even possible?
There are thousands, if not millions of Beast masters talent in the country alone. How could he be the strongest of them all?
Then he realized his full potential!
He can hunt monsters, absorb their essence, and merge them according to his wishes, creating unstoppable abominations with different traits that doesn't exist.
But in a world where evil lurks and people kill for the slightest reason his creations might be his only chance to survive!
[Griffin + Dragon = Hellfire-void Dragon (Mythic Grade)]
[Vampire + werewolf = Hybrid Werepire!]

Kim Gwang-seob, the investment expert from the Yeouido Shoe Shop.

1019146.synopsis:
[Female Protagonist + No System + Evil Demon + Muzan's Faction + Pillar Slayer]
Many years later, when Tsugikuni Mitsuba faces the final battle against the Demon Slayer Corps at Infinity Castle, she will recall that morning when she brought Yoriichi to watch Michikatsu practice swordsmanship.
Perhaps it was from that day that the fate of the three Tsugikuni siblings was sealed...
My name is Tsugikuni Mitsuba, younger sister of the Child of God, Upper Rank One of the Twelve Kizuki, best secretary of Demon King Muzan, thief of divine authority, manipulator of fate, the only usurper in this world, and the nightmare of the Demon Slayer Corps for hundreds of years.
And also, the ender of the Ubuyashiki Clan's thousand-year obsession.
"People die every moment in this world. Who kills them, who is killed—what difference does it make?"
"Magnificent resolve! Then let me see clearly whether you can break free from this prison called fate!"
"Alright, let's wrap this up quickly. I still have to rush back for a meeting later..."
PS: The female protagonist is a pure demon from Muzan's faction, not a spy demon with a body in the demon camp but a heart in the Demon Slayer Corps.

"I don't know what this feeling is … I don't know what I should do now … all I know is, I want him."



They fight one another, they chase after one another, they capture one another—a turbulent tale of preteens on the brink of self-destruction, masterfully brought to life by George Asakura!

Her husband abuses her on a daily basis.  Unable to stand it any longer, she asks her lesbian friend to kill her husband for her.  And unable to say no to the woman she loves, the lesbian kills him...


Only 22 years old when the series began, Ching Nakamura offers up a work carved from flesh, blood, and bone.

A sigh, chin on one hand, and those tired eyes... That’s Tanaka-kun, perpetually listless as he is. He and a quiet giant, Ohta-kun, who can’t seem to turn a blind eye to Tanaka-kun, come together in this slow, leisurely, and obstinately lazy coming-of-age comedy.



(Source: MANGA UP! Global)

The ninja adventures continue with Naruto’s son, Boruto!



Naruto was a young shinobi with an incorrigible knack for mischief. He achieved his dream to become the greatest ninja in his village, and now his face sits atop the Hokage monument. But this is not his story... A new generation of ninja are ready to take the stage, led by Naruto's own son, Boruto!



Years have passed since Naruto and Sasuke teamed up to defeat Kaguya, the progenitor of chakra and the greatest threat the ninja world has ever faced. Times are now peaceful and the new generation of shinobi has not experienced the same hardships as its parents. Perhaps that is why Boruto would rather play video games than train. However, one passion does burn deep in this ninja boy’s heart, and that is the desire to defeat his father!



(Source: VIZ Media)



Note: Includes the one-shot "Naruto: The Path Lit by the Full Moon".

2097418.synopsis:
The "surreal gag" comedy manga revolves around three classmates who play simple hand games. One of the girls is good at games, but hates them as she always lost to her older sister and forced to do chores while growing up. Another girl is of American descent, but raised in Japan, and who only pretends to be bad at Japanese. Another girl usually observes their games, and loses to the other girls.



(Source: Anime News Network)



Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

2106890.synopsis:
Shy and introverted, Tadokoro Kageko passes her free time in class drawing instead of hanging out with her classmates. But even when her classmates approach her, it’s only to make fun of her drawings and appearance. In stark contrast, Nikaidou Sakurako is well-liked among her peers as she has both beauty and smarts. And while everyone makes fun of Tadokoro, Nikaidou on the other hand, is totally infatuated with her. Just one look at one of Tadokoro’s drawings and Nikaidou fell in love with the art and eventually, the artist herself. When Tadokoro offers to draw Nikaidou a portrait, Nikaidou becomes ecstatic as this may be her chance to get closer with the girl she has been obsessing over. 

(Source: Lilyka Manga)

2107658.synopsis:
After the death of his beloved girlfriend, police officer Kyung-Joon just wants to be left alone to water his house plants and catch criminals. But after a police investigation into a mysterious cult goes supernatural, Kyung-Joon finds himself unwillingly caught up in a world of demons, succubi and monsters - and the worst of them all is a demon king calling himself "Lord Cain." It turns out that in order to survive, Cain needs mana that can only be accessed through a "door" inside Kyung-Joon. The problem is... how is he planning to open that door?



(Source: Tappytoon)



Note: Includes 33 extra chapters.

2110218.synopsis:
The summer of freshman year of high school. A boy named Hodaka runs away from his island home and goes to Tokyo, where he spends every day in loneliness. Then, in a corner of the bustling city he meets a girl named Hina. But he soon finds out that she possesses a mysterious power.



(Source: Kodansha USA, edited)

2113802.synopsis:
Tachibana Hinata and Jinguji Tsukasa are two young men who have been friends since childhood. After a disaster of a singles mixer, they’re sent flying into another world by a mysterious being–and now Tachibana is a beautiful blonde girl! When Jinguji angrily demands that they be returned home and go back to normal, they get cursed, and the only way out is for them to go on a quest and defeat the demon king. But…now the two friends can’t stop thinking about how hot the other is. Will they save the world before their lifelong bromance becomes a romance?

A manga about four teenagers and their four stories of unrequited love. When you don't want to lose a friendship but long for something more, the only thing you can do is gaze at your beloved's face, turned away...



One might call Hikari extraordinarily ordinary. One day, she takes up a new hobby—imagining what a romance would be like between her pretty friend Mari and the cute guy in their class, Otani. The world discovered the essence of the human soul, Ideia, and found a way to materialize it. The stronger one's Ideia, the more power one has. With only two years left of high school, will Jinsung be able to hide his killer side and prove rank isn't everything?

Lee Myeong-Jun, Vice Chairman of Hyundo Group, lost his daughter to the Iljin group. For revenge, he adopts Yoon Ga-Ram, a psychopathic North Korean defector. She is a sadistic human weapon born after North Korea's drug experiments. A psychopath girl who killed everyone at the lab and escaped North Korea alone. Yoon Ga-Ram has just been released from a juvenile detention center in South-Korea.

(Source: Anime News Network)

3002890.synopsis:
A young boy named Sosuke rescues a goldfish named Ponyo, and they embark on a fantastic journey of friendship and discovery before Ponyo's father, a powerful sorcerer, forces her to return to her home in the sea. But Ponyo's desire to be human upsets the delicate balance of nature and triggers a gigantic storm. Only Ponyo's mother, a beautiful sea goddess, can restore nature's balance and make Ponyo's dreams come true.

A new cast of characters take on the continued battle between good and evil. Ginga, our hero, and his group of loyal friends take on a dangerous group called the Dark Nebula. The Dark Nebula’s sole mission is to take over the world and unleash their evil upon it; but before they can do so, they must destroy Ginga as he is the only person that’s strong enough to stand in their way. The plot thickens as friends become enemies and enemies become allies. Everything starts and ends with Ginga as he struggles to find the strength to defend his world and the honor of Beyblade.

Most young women have lots of obsessions, but Sakurako Kujou only has two: work and bones… and since the bones are part of her work, it really comes down to just bones. However, in between collecting de-fleshed animal and human remains for her studies, Sakurako also assists the local police as a forensic consultant, where she's developed a formidable reputation as both a corpse magnet and detective.



Assisting her in these tasks is young Shoutarou Tatewaki, who is no slouch at sleuthing himself, though his primary task is to keep Sakurako focused (and keep her from occasionally "borrowing" a particularly interesting specimen). If there's a bone to pick, a stray skull to be found, or a random skeleton hidden in a closet, you can trust this team to unearth the evidence.

Mysteria Academy is a prestigious magic school that teaches without discrimination to the three factions (humans, gods and demons) who otherwise are usually at battle with each other. (Source: Anime News Network)

3021578.synopsis:
The anime centers on two boys who were never meant to meet: Tsukushi Tsukamoto, who has no special skills but secretly hides a passionate heart, and Jin Kazama, an isolated soccer genius. On a stormy night, the two meet, and that meeting creates a whirlwind in the world of high school soccer.



(Source: Anime News Network)

3127050.synopsis:
Two assassins face off. The cool bounty hunter Chateau and the mysterious and powerful Ryang-ha. Chateau and Ryang-ha become enemies after this fight—at least, they should have, but for some reason Ryang-ha takes a liking to Chateau and begins following her around.



Little by little, Chateau develops a cooperative partnership with Ryang-ha, which gets her caught up in the struggle against the organizations hunting him down. Furthermore, that battle is related to her past as well. Two mismatched assassins weave together a twisted "Assassin X Assassin" thriller. The strange gears of fate begin to move.



(Source: Crunchyroll)



Note: The first episode had an early premiere at AnimeNYC 2021.

3142666.synopsis:
After finally adopting a child, the Sonoyamas were unprepared for the mystery that would soon unravel. Hitori seems to be the perfect son for his loving parents. He's handsome, intelligent, and grateful for his new lavish life—but he has a dark secret. Hitori is actually the twins Migi and Dali pretending to be one boy. And they have a terrifying motive behind their hidden identity.



(Source: Crunchyroll)

3153930.synopsis:
Anzu Hoshino is a "non-heroine type" high school girl who pays no attention to fashion or romance and spends every day playing video games. When the wizard Riri suddenly appears, Anzu is forced to participate in the Magical World's project to stop population decline. This romantic comedy depicts what happens when Anzu goes from living a life immersed in her three favorite things — video games, chocolate, and cats — to being surrounded by handsome guys. Anzu is steadfast in her claim that she never wanted to live in a dating simulation game. She meets a handsome guy who is so popular it hurts, a clean-cut and athletic childhood friend, and a beautiful rich young guy who is naive about the outside world. By meeting Anzu, they all begin to change gradually.
